verses.original: γίνεσθε Μιμηταί μου καθὼς κἀγὼ Χριστοῦ
verses.transliteration: ginesthe Mimētai mou kathōs kagō Christou
verses.literal: You are to imitate me just as I [imitate] Christ

verses.original: δὲ Ἐπαινῶ ὑμᾶς ὅτι μέμνησθε μου πάντα καὶ κατέχετε τὰς παραδόσεις καθὼς παρέδωκα ὑμῖν
verses.transliteration: de Epainō hymas hoti memnēsthe mou panta kai katechete tas paradoseis kathōs paredōka hymin
verses.literal: Now I commend you for remembering me in everything and [for] maintaining the traditions just as I passed [them] on to you

verses.original: δὲ Θέλω ὑμᾶς εἰδέναι ὅτι ἡ κεφαλὴ παντὸς ἀνδρὸς ἐστιν ὁ Χριστός δὲ κεφαλὴ γυναικὸς ὁ ἀνήρ δὲ κεφαλὴ τοῦ Χριστοῦ ὁ Θεός
verses.transliteration: de Thelō hymas eidenai hoti hē kephalē pantos andros estin ho Christos de kephalē gynaikos ho anēr de kephalē tou Christou ho Theos
verses.literal: But I want you to understand that the head of every man is - Christ and [the] head of [the] woman - [is] man and [the] head - of Christ - [is] God

verses.original: Πᾶς ἀνὴρ προσευχόμενος ἢ προφητεύων ἔχων κεφαλῆς κατὰ καταισχύνει αὐτοῦ τὴν κεφαλὴν
verses.transliteration: Pas anēr proseuchomenos ē prophēteuōn echōn kephalēs kata kataischynei autou tēn kephalēn
verses.literal: Every man [who] prays or prophesies with [his] head covered dishonors his - head

verses.original: δὲ πᾶσα γυνὴ προσευχομένη ἢ προφητεύουσα τῇ κεφαλῇ ἀκατακαλύπτῳ καταισχύνει αὐτῆς τὴν κεφαλὴν γάρ ἐστιν ἓν καὶ τὸ αὐτὸ τῇ ἐξυρημένῃ
verses.transliteration: de pasa gynē proseuchomenē ē prophēteuousa tē kephalē akatakalyptō kataischynei autēs tēn kephalēn gar estin hen kai to auto tē exyrēmenē
verses.literal: And every woman [who] prays or prophesies with [her] head uncovered dishonors her - head for it is vvv vvv vvv just [as if] - her head were shaved

verses.original: γὰρ εἰ γυνή οὐ κατακαλύπτεται καὶ κειράσθω δὲ εἰ αἰσχρὸν γυναικὶ τὸ κείρασθαι ἢ ξυρᾶσθαι κατακαλυπτέσθω
verses.transliteration: gar ei gynē ou katakalyptetai kai keirasthō de ei aischron gynaiki to keirasthai ē xyrasthai katakalyptesthō
verses.literal: - If a woman {does} not cover her head - she should have her hair cut off And if [it is] shameful for a woman - to have her hair cut or shaved off she should cover her head

verses.original: γὰρ μὲν Ἀνὴρ ὀφείλει οὐκ κατακαλύπτεσθαι τὴν κεφαλήν ὑπάρχων εἰκὼν καὶ δόξα Θεοῦ δὲ ἡ γυνὴ ἐστιν δόξα ἀνδρός
verses.transliteration: gar men Anēr opheilei ouk katakalyptesthai tēn kephalēn hyparchōn eikōn kai doxa Theou de hē gynē estin doxa andros
verses.literal: - - A man ought not to cover [his] head [since] he is [the] image and glory of God but the woman is [the] glory of man

verses.original: γάρ ἀνὴρ ἐστιν οὐ ἐκ γυναικός ἀλλὰ γυνὴ ἐξ ἀνδρός
verses.transliteration: gar anēr estin ou ek gynaikos alla gynē ex andros
verses.literal: For man did not come . . . from woman but woman from man

verses.original: καὶ γὰρ οὐκ ἀνὴρ ἐκτίσθη διὰ τὴν γυναῖκα ἀλλὰ γυνὴ διὰ τὸν ἄνδρα
verses.transliteration: kai gar ouk anēr ektisthē dia tēn gynaika alla gynē dia ton andra
verses.literal: Neither . . . . . . {was} man created for - woman but woman for - man

verses.original: διὰ τοῦτο ἡ γυνὴ ὀφείλει ἔχειν ἐξουσίαν ἐπὶ τῆς κεφαλῆς διὰ τοὺς ἀγγέλους
verses.transliteration: dia touto hē gynē opheilei echein exousian epi tēs kephalēs dia tous angelous
verses.literal: For this reason . . . - a woman ought to have a sign of authority on [her] head because of the angels

verses.original: ἐν Κυρίῳ Πλὴν γυνὴ οὔτε χωρὶς ἀνδρὸς οὔτε ἀνὴρ χωρὶς γυναικὸς
verses.transliteration: en Kyriō Plēn gynē oute chōris andros oute anēr chōris gynaikos
verses.literal: In [the] Lord however woman [is] not independent [of] man nor [is] man independent of woman

verses.original: γὰρ ὥσπερ ἡ γυνὴ ἐκ τοῦ ἀνδρός οὕτως καὶ ὁ ἀνὴρ διὰ τῆς γυναικός δὲ τὰ πάντα ἐκ τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: gar hōsper hē gynē ek tou andros houtōs kai ho anēr dia tēs gynaikos de ta panta ek tou Theou
verses.literal: For just as - woman [came] from - man so also - man [is] born of - woman But - everything [comes] from - God

verses.original: κρίνατε Ἐν ὑμῖν αὐτοῖς ἐστὶν πρέπον γυναῖκα προσεύχεσθαι τῷ Θεῷ ἀκατακάλυπτον
verses.transliteration: krinate En hymin autois estin prepon gynaika proseuchesthai tō Theō akatakalypton
verses.literal: Judge for vvv yourselves Is it proper for a woman to pray - to God with her head uncovered

verses.original: οὐδὲ φύσις αὐτὴ ἡ διδάσκει ὑμᾶς ὅτι μὲν ἐὰν ἀνὴρ κομᾷ ἐστιν ἀτιμία αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: oude physis autē hē didaskei hymas hoti men ean anēr koma estin atimia autō
verses.literal: Doesn’t nature itself - teach you that vvv if a man has long hair it is a disgrace to him

verses.original: δὲ ἐὰν γυνὴ κομᾷ ἐστιν αὐτῇ δόξα ὅτι ἡ κόμη δέδοται αὐτῇ ἀντὶ περιβολαίου
verses.transliteration: de ean gynē koma estin autē doxa hoti hē komē dedotai autē anti peribolaiou
verses.literal: but [that] if a woman has long hair it is her glory For - long hair is given to her as a covering

verses.original: δέ Εἰ τις δοκεῖ εἶναι φιλόνεικος ἡμεῖς ἔχομεν οὐκ τοιαύτην συνήθειαν οὐδὲ αἱ ἐκκλησίαι τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: de Ei tis dokei einai philoneikos hēmeis echomen ouk toiautēn synētheian oude hai ekklēsiai tou Theou
verses.literal: - If anyone is inclined to dispute [this] . . . . . . we have no [other] practice nor [do] the churches - of God

verses.original: δὲ Τοῦτο παραγγέλλων οὐκ ἐπαινῶ ὅτι συνέρχεσθε οὐκ ἀλλὰ εἰς τὸ ἧσσον εἰς τὸ κρεῖσσον
verses.transliteration: de Touto parangellōn ouk epainō hoti synerchesthe ouk alla eis to hēsson eis to kreisson
verses.literal: - In the [following] instructions vvv I have no praise to offer because your gatherings vvv vvv vvv vvv do more harm vvv vvv than good

verses.original: γὰρ μὲν πρῶτον ἀκούω ὑμῶν συνερχομένων ἐν ἐκκλησίᾳ ὑπάρχειν σχίσματα ἐν ὑμῖν καὶ μέρος πιστεύω τι
verses.transliteration: gar men prōton akouō hymōn synerchomenōn en ekklēsia hyparchein schismata en hymin kai meros pisteuō ti
verses.literal: vvv vvv First of all I hear that [when] you come together as a church there are divisions among you and in part I believe it

verses.original: καὶ γὰρ δεῖ εἶναι αἱρέσεις ἐν ὑμῖν ἵνα γένωνται φανεροὶ καὶ οἱ ἐν ὑμῖν δόκιμοι
verses.transliteration: kai gar dei einai haireseis en hymin hina genōntai phaneroi kai hoi en hymin dokimoi
verses.literal: And indeed there must be differences among you to vvv show - which of you are approved

verses.original: οὖν ὑμῶν Συνερχομένων ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτὸ ἔστιν οὐκ κυριακὸν δεῖπνον φαγεῖν
verses.transliteration: oun hymōn Synerchomenōn epi to auto estin ouk kyriakon deipnon phagein
verses.literal: Now then [when] you come together . . . . . . . . . it is not [the] Lord’s Supper you eat

verses.original: γὰρ ἐν τῷ φαγεῖν ἕκαστος προλαμβάνει τὸ ἴδιον δεῖπνον καὶ μὲν ὃς πεινᾷ δὲ ὃς μεθύει
verses.transliteration: gar en tō phagein hekastos prolambanei to idion deipnon kai men hos peina de hos methyei
verses.literal: For as - you eat each [of you] goes ahead without sharing his - meal - While [one] remains hungry - [another] gets drunk

verses.original: γὰρ οὐκ ἔχετε μὴ οἰκίας εἰς τὸ ἐσθίειν καὶ πίνειν ἢ καταφρονεῖτε τῆς ἐκκλησίας τοῦ Θεοῦ καὶ καταισχύνετε τοὺς ἔχοντας μὴ τί εἴπω ὑμῖν ἐπαινέσω ὑμᾶς ἐν τούτῳ οὐκ ἐπαινῶ
verses.transliteration: gar ouk echete mē oikias eis to esthiein kai pinein ē kataphroneite tēs ekklēsias tou Theou kai kataischynete tous echontas mē ti eipō hymin epainesō hymas en toutō ouk epainō
verses.literal: Don’t . . . you have [your own] homes in which to eat and drink Or do you despise the church - of God and humiliate those who have nothing What can I say to you Shall I praise you for this No I will not

verses.original: γὰρ Ἐγὼ παρέλαβον ἀπὸ τοῦ Κυρίου ὃ καὶ παρέδωκα ὑμῖν ὅτι ὁ Κύριος Ἰησοῦς ἐν τῇ νυκτὶ ᾗ παρεδίδετο ἔλαβεν ἄρτον
verses.transliteration: gar Egō parelabon apo tou Kyriou ho kai paredōka hymin hoti ho Kyrios Iēsous en tē nykti hē paredideto elaben arton
verses.literal: For I received from the Lord what vvv I also passed on to you - The Lord Jesus on the night - He was betrayed took bread

verses.original: καὶ εὐχαριστήσας ἔκλασεν καὶ εἶπεν Τοῦτό ἐστιν μού τὸ σῶμα τὸ ὑπὲρ ὑμῶν ποιεῖτε τοῦτο εἰς ἀνάμνησιν τὴν ἐμὴν
verses.transliteration: kai eucharistēsas eklasen kai eipen Touto estin mou to sōma to hyper hymōn poieite touto eis anamnēsin tēn emēn
verses.literal: and when He had given thanks He broke [it] and said This is My - body which [is] for you do this in remembrance - of Me

verses.original: ὡσαύτως καὶ μετὰ τὸ δειπνῆσαι τὸ ποτήριον λέγων Τοῦτο τὸ ποτήριον ἐστὶν ἡ καινὴ διαθήκη ἐν ἐμῷ τῷ αἵματι ποιεῖτε τοῦτο ὁσάκις ἐὰν πίνητε εἰς τὴν ἀνάμνησιν ἐμὴν
verses.transliteration: hōsautōs kai meta to deipnēsai to potērion legōn Touto to potērion estin hē kainē diathēkē en emō tō haimati poieite touto hosakis ean pinēte eis tēn anamnēsin emēn
verses.literal: In the same way . . . after - supper [He took] the cup saying This - cup is the new covenant in My - blood do this as often as vvv you drink [it] in - remembrance of Me

verses.original: γὰρ ὁσάκις ἐὰν ἐσθίητε τοῦτον τὸν ἄρτον καὶ πίνητε τὸ ποτήριον καταγγέλλετε τοῦ Κυρίου τὸν θάνατον ἄχρι οὗ ἔλθῃ
verses.transliteration: gar hosakis ean esthiēte touton ton arton kai pinēte to potērion katangellete tou Kyriou ton thanaton achri hou elthē
verses.literal: For as often as vvv you eat this - bread and drink [this] cup you proclaim the Lord’s - death until . . . He comes

verses.original: Ὥστε ὃς ἂν ἐσθίῃ τὸν ἄρτον ἢ πίνῃ τὸ ποτήριον τοῦ Κυρίου ἀναξίως ἔσται ἔνοχος τοῦ σώματος καὶ τοῦ αἵματος τοῦ Κυρίου
verses.transliteration: Hōste hos an esthiē ton arton ē pinē to potērion tou Kyriou anaxiōs estai enochos tou sōmatos kai tou haimatos tou Kyriou
verses.literal: Therefore whoever . . . eats the bread or drinks the cup of the Lord in an unworthy manner will be guilty of sinning against the body and - blood of the Lord

verses.original: δὲ ἄνθρωπος δοκιμαζέτω ἑαυτόν καὶ οὕτως ἐσθιέτω ἐκ τοῦ ἄρτου καὶ πινέτω ἐκ τοῦ ποτηρίου
verses.transliteration: de anthrōpos dokimazetō heauton kai houtōs esthietō ek tou artou kai pinetō ek tou potēriou
verses.literal: - Each one must examine himself [before] . . . he eats of the bread and drinks of the cup

verses.original: γὰρ ὁ ἐσθίων καὶ πίνων μὴ διακρίνων τὸ σῶμα ἐσθίει καὶ πίνει κρίμα ἑαυτῷ
verses.transliteration: gar ho esthiōn kai pinōn mē diakrinōn to sōma esthiei kai pinei krima heautō
verses.literal: For anyone who eats and drinks without recognizing the body eats and drinks judgment on himself

verses.original: διὰ τοῦτο πολλοὶ ἐν ὑμῖν ἀσθενεῖς καὶ ἄρρωστοι καὶ ἱκανοί κοιμῶνται
verses.transliteration: dia touto polloi en hymin astheneis kai arrōstoi kai hikanoi koimōntai
verses.literal: That is why . . . many among you [are] weak and sick and a number [of you] have fallen asleep

verses.original: δὲ Εἰ διεκρίνομεν ἑαυτοὺς ἂν οὐκ ἐκρινόμεθα
verses.transliteration: de Ei diekrinomen heautous an ouk ekrinometha
verses.literal: Now if we judged ourselves {properly} vvv vvv we would not come under judgment

verses.original: δὲ κρινόμενοι ὑπὸ τοῦ Κυρίου παιδευόμεθα ἵνα μὴ κατακριθῶμεν σὺν τῷ κόσμῳ
verses.transliteration: de krinomenoi hypo tou Kyriou paideuometha hina mē katakrithōmen syn tō kosmō
verses.literal: But when we are judged by the Lord we are being disciplined so that vvv we will not be condemned with the world

verses.original: Ὥστε μου ἀδελφοί συνερχόμενοι εἰς τὸ φαγεῖν ἐκδέχεσθε ἀλλήλους
verses.transliteration: Hōste mou adelphoi synerchomenoi eis to phagein ekdechesthe allēlous
verses.literal: So my brothers when you come together to - eat wait for one another

verses.original: εἴ τις πεινᾷ ἐσθιέτω ἐν οἴκῳ ἵνα συνέρχησθε μὴ εἰς κρίμα δὲ ὡς ἂν ἔλθω διατάξομαι Τὰ λοιπὰ
verses.transliteration: ei tis peina esthietō en oikō hina synerchēsthe mē eis krima de hōs an elthō diataxomai Ta loipa
verses.literal: If anyone is hungry he should eat at home so that when you come together [it will not result] in judgment And when vvv I come I will give instructions about the remaining matters
